name: selection-bar
title: Selection bar and lasso
description: A glass toolbar over the person's selection: how many cards are selected, then Comment, Move to, Reset places, Remove, Bookmark all, Save for later, Width and Zoom (the page passes them in one buttons list). Centred above the selection, below it when there is no room, drawn above the cards and moving nothing; it follows pan and zoom. A lasso that touches no card gets the area bar, which only offers Zoom to this area. The dashed lasso box (.vb-lasso) is styled here too (Architect .selbar and .lasso; 3_FE_02 rulings 1-2). With the selectionPill flag the bar is compact (24px buttons) and over a selection starts as a pill, "3 selected" and a chevron, that opens it (stage5-follow-ups FE_02).

files.core: selection-bar-core.ts (placeBar, pillGap, barView, placeGrid, gridStep, boxBetween, touches, boxAround; no DOM)
files.template: selection-bar-template.ts (selectionBarTemplate: the only place the markup is built)
files.styles: selection-bar.css (scoped by the tag, and .vb-lasso; tokens only)

placement: With the selectionGrid flag too (selection-grid task, maintainer points 773 and 775) the pill opens into a 3×3 grid (the 'grid' state): the label, Reset places and Remove; a divider; Save for later, Width, Zoom; Move to, Comment, Bookmark all, each with its icon. Over a selection of cards the bar sits pillGap(zoom) above the selection's top edge (page polish ruling C): the cards' top tabs scale with zoom (TAB_RISE, 10 world px above the card) and the bar does not, so the gap is the tabs' rise at that zoom plus a clear space of 8px per unit of zoom, never under 4px (zoomed out) nor over 16px (zoomed in): 6px at zoom 0.2, 18px at 1, 41px at 2.5. The bar never covers the tabs, so a press on them grabs the card. The area bar (no cards under it) and the bar below a selection keep BAR_GAP (12px). The open grid: placeGrid puts its anchor cell's centre at the click on the pill (from the keyboard, the pill's centre), upward (data-side above, the label's row on top) when it fits, else downward (below) with its rows reversed, so the anchor stays under the pointer and the label's row, with Remove, stays farthest; kept inside the stage. It follows the pill's place as the view moves.

parts.vb-sb-count: '3 selected'; absent on the area bar and with the pill
parts.vb-sb-pill: with the pill (selectionPill): a button, '3 selected' and a chevron (vb-sb-chevron), aria-expanded; first in the bar, the buttons after it show only while it is open; in the grid, cell 0, its label centred, muted, at regular weight (one below the closed pill's medium) with no chevron, and a click closes the grid
parts.vb-sb-btn: one button per command the page passes (data-command), title and aria-label from its `title` when it has one; vb-sb-primary for Comment; Bookmark all turns to Remove bookmarks when every selected node has one; disabled when the command has nothing to act on (Reset places with no moved card selected); in the grid, its row (data-row 1-3), its icon (vb-sb-icon) when the page gives one, vb-sb-danger for Remove, and data-anchor on the cell that opens under the pointer
parts.vb-sb-divider: the grid only: a thin line after the first row (decoration)
parts.vb-sb-gap: the grid only: an empty cell where the page has no command for that slot, so the grid keeps its shape

attributes.data-side: above | below: where it sits by the selection; for the open grid, whether it opens upward or downward with its rows reversed (set by place)
attributes.data-pill: the compact bar, from BarView.pill (set by show)
attributes.data-open: the pill is open: its buttons show (set by show from BarView.open)
attributes.hidden: set by the page whenever the selection is empty, or a note bubble, the conversation box or a node's own menu or box is open (the bar steps aside so it never covers them)
attributes.data-grid: the grid, from BarView.cells (set by show)

methods.show(v: BarView): draws it from selectionBarTemplate; redraws only when what it says changed
methods.place(p: BarPlacement): left, top and data-side from placeBar, in its offset parent's pixels
methods.anchor(): the open grid's anchor cell as drawn, { x, reach }, for placeGrid; null without the grid

events: vb-command (bubbles): detail { command }, the id of the pressed button from the page's command table

vb-toggle (bubbles): detail { open, at? }, the pill was pressed (click or Enter) and asks to open or close; `at` is the pointer's client point (none from the keyboard); the page decides and shows the bar again
whenToUse: Acting on several selected cards at once, or zooming to a lassoed area.
whenNotToUse: Actions on one card (its own footer buttons and keys), or anything that needs a typed answer (the note bubble).
accessibility: role=toolbar with a name. No Clear button: a click on empty board and Esc clear the selection. Remove and Zoom are short words whose title (the tooltip, and the accessible name) says the whole meaning and the key ("Zoom to the selection · Z"). The pill is a button with aria-expanded; Esc closes the open bar and puts focus back on the pill; the selection's keys work with the pill closed. Every command also has a key (N or C comment, Z zoom to the selection, Delete removes, Esc clears), and the selection itself is announced by the board's polite live region. Real buttons with visible labels and a focus ring. The lasso box is decoration (pointer-events none); the keyboard route to a group is Space on each card. The grid: the anchor cell takes focus as it opens (the pill keeps it when the anchor is empty or disabled); the arrow keys move between the cells that take focus, Up and Down as drawn; every cell is a 24px target with its focus ring inside it; Remove's red is the glass's cross colour (a checked 45-tier pair).
